title: 三维跨层资源选择与分层搜索
research_question: 针对离散固定的跨层资源，候选端口选择和局部搜索能否改善三维布线的求解时间与质量？

variants.description: 两层有向图含两个固定垂直端口，逐个限制端口求局部路径，并与不限制端口的参考路径一起输出。
固定版本原始 VPR：ex5p 两种布局的独立 baseline 入口已接入；完整比较矩阵待扩展
树上选择/共享：后续实现
同一算法 FPGA 候选评估

controlled_factors: 端口候选数及分层搜索策略

real_run_settings.timing_mode: VPR native model STA; route-only CPU wall time and VPR Routing took measured separately

notes: Legacy smoke/plan schema retains planned matrix status. Original VPR is executable via standalone baseline on explicitly registered model datasets; algorithm variants remain planned. Pilot uses seed 1, three repetitions; seeds 2/3 remain future campaign settings. Null quality tolerance is unset.
